threat_event: Attacker takes over the edge router through its management interface or an unpatched flaw, then captures home phone signaling (call detail), redirects subscriber traffic, or cuts service
threat_source: Cybercriminal or botnet operator (including infected devices on customer networks)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Router management answered from the internet until 2026-07-23 and still answers from about 310 subscriber networks; firmware two releases behind a critical vendor advisory; shared admin password; logs lost at reboot
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 edge router; BP-01; BP-02 (CPNI in transit)
existing_controls: Management blocked from the internet 2026-07-23; VPN for remote management
treatment_plan: Update firmware and rework management filters so only the management VLAN and VPN reach the router; named admin accounts; remote log server; subscribe to vendor and CISA KEV advisories; monthly external port check

threat_event: Takeover of the VoIP reseller portal account; attacker exports call detail for all 58 lines or sets call forwarding for toll fraud
threat_source: Cybercriminal (phishing, password reuse, or infostealer on the laptop)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA offered but off; password saved in the laptop browser; portal activity never reviewed
treatment_plan: Turn on portal MFA; move the password to a password manager and clear browser-saved passwords; monthly review of portal activity; ask the provider for toll fraud alerts

threat_event: Someone other than the account holder obtains home phone call history through the AI support assistant (pretexting with an account number and ZIP code from a bill or mailing)
threat_source: Pretexter (for example, an estranged partner or a data broker)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Text-line channel verified with account number and service ZIP code, which are account information; assistant turned on without review; account change notices only for password changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 AI support assistant; SYS-01; BP-03
existing_controls: Call history skill turned off on the text line 2026-07-22; 14 past sessions checked with account holders
treatment_plan: Show CPNI only inside a signed-in portal session; text line answers outages and general questions only; turn on change notices for email of record and service address; reassess in P10 before any new skill

threat_event: Shared or reused credentials (router admin shared with the consultant, installer login on the radio controller, one password on every access point) are misused after leaking or after a contractor relationship ends
threat_source: Former contractor or outsider holding a leaked shared password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No named accounts on network devices or the installer role; no record of who changed what; no password changes when people leave
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 radio controller; SYS-05 network devices; BP-01
existing_controls: Consultant signed confidentiality and security terms 2026-07-17
treatment_plan: Named accounts for the owner, consultant, and contractor (installer role) with MFA where offered; unique access point passwords from the controller; change shared passwords now and whenever a helper leaves

threat_event: FCC enforcement because no annual CPNI certification was filed for 2023 to 2025 and CALEA security policies were never filed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner did not know the home phone add-on made the company subject to the CPNI and CALEA filing duties
treatment_plan: With counsel: decide how to address the missed certifications, file the CALEA policies through CEFS, and file the calendar year 2026 CPNI certification with an accurate statement by 2027-03-01

threat_event: A CPNI breach is not recognized, law enforcement is not notified within 7 business days, or customers are told before the law enforcement hold ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written breach procedure, breach record, or reporting facility access; owner unaware of the 64.2011 sequence
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; locate the reporting facility link and FBI and USSS contacts; keep a breach record for 2 years

threat_event: Monthly CDR exports on the laptop or in email are stolen by malware, through an email takeover, or with a lost laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports kept in the downloads folder and email since 2023 and never deleted
existing_controls: Laptop full-disk encryption; email MFA; antivirus
treatment_plan: Import CDRs from the portal straight into billing where the vendors support it; otherwise delete each export after the billing check; never email exports; purge old copies

threat_event: A lawful intercept order for broadband cannot be carried out, or an intercept is set up without proper authorization and records
threat_source: Law enforcement request handled without a procedure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CALEA policies, senior officer designation, record template, or broadband intercept solution; VoIP intercepts depend on the wholesale provider
existing_controls: Wholesale VoIP contract covers VoIP intercepts
treatment_plan: Write and file CALEA policies with a 24x7 contact appendix; record template under 1.20004; get quotes from a CALEA trusted third party or arrange delivery through the upstream provider

threat_event: Upstream fiber cut or SITE-1 power loss beyond battery takes down all service, including 911 calling on the home phone lines
threat_source: Upstream provider failure; utility power failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One upstream circuit; about 2 hours of battery at SITE-1; generator started by hand
existing_controls: Battery backup; manual generator; terms tell home phone customers to keep a mobile phone
treatment_plan: Automatic transfer switch for the generator; price a second upstream (fixed wireless backhaul to a second provider at SITE-2); outage message templates

threat_event: Owner-operator suddenly unavailable or without the phone, so nobody can restore the network or reach customers and vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA on one phone; no standby help
treatment_plan: Sealed emergency access envelope with the owner's attorney; standby agreement with the network consultant; recorded outage messages (P05)

threat_event: Router or switch configuration lost (hardware failure or an attacker wiping it), and the 4-month-old copy makes restore slow and incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Irregular configuration copies; no restore test
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 edge router and core switch; BP-01
existing_controls: Spare router in the shed; radio configurations held by the controller
treatment_plan: Weekly automatic configuration copy to the business file storage; restore test on the spare router twice a year

threat_event: Hurricane damages tower equipment and causes multi-day power loss at the sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Four tower sites in a hurricane area; limited battery at each site
existing_controls: Spare radios on hand; owner walks sites before the season
treatment_plan: Pre-season checklist each May (mounts, batteries, fuel); spare radio kit; watch for FCC DIRS activation (counsel to confirm whether DIRS reporting applies)

threat_event: Breach at the billing vendor or wholesale VoIP provider exposes subscriber PII or CPNI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company relies on vendor controls; the VoIP provider has no SOC 2 report and no breach notice terms
existing_controls: Billing vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report reviewed 2026-07-23; VoIP provider security questionnaire 2026-08-12
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Review the billing vendor's report every year; ask the VoIP provider for breach notice terms at renewal

threat_event: A home phone line's 911 registered address is wrong (customer moved the ATA or the address was mistyped), so emergency help goes to the wrong place
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Addresses entered by hand in the VoIP portal; no periodic confirmation with customers
regulatory_driver: 47 CFR 9.11 (interconnected VoIP E911; outside the vertical requirement list)
existing_controls: Address checked against the install record at activation
treatment_plan: Confirm every home phone 911 address with customers each year and after any move; tell customers not to move ATAs without calling

threat_event: Vendor-default credentials on network devices let an outsider change radio settings or read device data (found in P07: SITE-3 access point)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor installed an access point without changing the default password and SNMP community string; no post-install check
existing_controls: Changed 2026-07-23 on the SITE-3 access point
treatment_plan: Check every device for default credentials and SNMP settings; add a post-install checklist for the contractor; apply settings from a controller template
